caption:
The video captures an upward view of a partly cloudy sky dominated by a large, dark grey overcast cloud mass filling the top and upper-right regions. Below this heavy formation, a bright white cumulus bank lines the bottom edge, while a softer grey-white cloud layer sits along the right side. A distinct band of clear blue sky separates the dark overhead mass from the white cumulus, with a few small, scattered wisps floating near the left edge.

Throughout, the cloud formations drift and deform only slowly and subtly. The lower edge of the dark overhead mass and the right-side grey cloud creep and reshape slightly relative to the white cumulus bank below, while the central blue-sky gap stays open. The bright white cumulus along the bottom remains largely in place. Its billowing edges change shape marginally rather than translating across the sky. No rapid motion or object entering occurs, and the camera appears essentially stationary, consistent with cloud motion and morphing.
